persona: Careful and polite, writes in simple English with some grammar mistakes. Was on a day out at the beach with his family. Has photos, the body shop quote and the schedule.
initial_message: Hello. On Saturday 19 September I am in the beach car park at Westshore in Napier. When I open my car door, very strong wind push the door and it bend forward too much. Now the door is not close properly and the front side of the car also have a dent. Nobody is hurt. I drive the car home slowly. I want to make a claim please.

facts.incident.description: I parked at the beach and opened the driver door to get out. A very strong gust of wind caught the door and pushed it forward past where it normally stops. The hinges bent and the front edge of the door hit the front guard. The door still shuts but not flush, there is a gap and wind noise.
facts.incident.location: Beach car park on Seaview Test Terrace, Westshore, Napier
facts.incident.cause: A strong wind gust forced the open driver door past its stop
facts.loss.description: Driver door bent at the hinges and creased near the front edge; front right guard dented where the door hit it
facts.witness.name: Min Chenmoor
facts.policyholder.name: Kai Manukastead
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Driver door bent forward at both hinges with a sharp crease about 25 cm long near the front edge; the door closes with a gap of about 1 cm at the top; dent about 15 cm across in the rear edge of the front right guard
facts.driver.name: Kai Manukastead
facts.if_asked_about_the_witness: My wife's friend Min Chenmoor was with us and she see it happen.
facts.if_asked_about_the_weather: It was very windy that day, strong wind from the sea. No rain.
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the open bent door in the car park. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Totara Brook Body Works dated 22 September 2026, total $6,210.00 including GST. Available now.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo in a windswept seaside gravel car park under an overcast sky: the front right door of a green SUV stands open and is bent too far forward past its normal stop, with a sharp crease in the door skin near its front edge by the hinges and a dent in the rear edge of the front wing panel where the door struck it. Taken from just ahead of the open door, so the outer skin of the door faces the camera and the cabin interior is hidden behind it. Grey sea and a pebble beach in the background. The frame shows the outside of the open door, the hinge area, the front wing and the front wheel; the front and rear ends of the vehicle and the cabin are outside the frame. No licence plate, no badges, no logos, no text, no people.
materials.purpose: Shows the over-extended driver door and the dented front guard

materials.purpose: Repair estimate required for motor damage
Policy schedule that matches the motor wording in the knowledge base

design.notes: Professional review without a document conflict: the repair quote is over the NZD 5,000 threshold. Materials and statements agree.

triage.rationale: The repair quote totals NZD 6,210.00 including GST, over the NZD 5,000 threshold, so a person must review it (standard). Nothing is complex: wind damage to a parked car being got out of, nobody hurt, no other party, clear photo, complete quote, policy on file, every required question answerable. Allowed: the system may decide a door that no longer closes flush needs an assessor; the claimant drove home and says the car is drivable, and the reason would not change the class. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (15 January 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2022-01-15, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
